claims.statement: Every desktop window runs with contextIsolation true and nodeIntegration false, and the renderer receives only the typed evidenceAPI object exposed through contextBridge, never ipcRenderer, fs or another Node module.

The preload surface is grouped into projects, agent, mcp, simulation, ingestion and system calls, each mapped to a channel named in a per-domain channel object (shared/ipc.ts, shared/agentIpc.ts, shared/mcpIpc.ts, shared/simulation.ts), every subscription returns an unsubscribe function, and the two answer paths (agent.respondPatch and mcp.respond) are one-way ipcRenderer.send calls replying to a request the main process started.

Startup assembles the project store, agent IPC, project/ingestion/review/simulation/delivery IPC, the MCP client-config sync and the MCP bridge before opening the dashboard; a client-config sync rejection degrades to empty updated/skipped/failed lists, a failed bridge start is reported to stderr and leaves the rest of the app running with registerMcpIpc skipped, and before-quit disposes the agent runtimes and the bridge.
With --mcp-stdio the same executable opens no window, reads no project store and registers nothing, running only the stdio MCP server against the derived endpoint.

The shell keeps one editor window per project root in a Map, focuses an existing window instead of opening a duplicate, removes the entry on close, and exposes the map through listEditorWindows for the MCP bridge.

The project store keeps no model in memory: open parses either a .evidence/fm tree (requiring model.json) or a *.evidence.json bundle, points modelRoot at the file for a bundle, remembers the project, and accepts a freshly created blank tree while refusing a source that yields no objects.
save writes a bundle back to the same file or a tree through writeModelDirectory, and reports the written, unchanged and removed file names so an idempotent save produces no churn.
Creating a project refuses an existing .evidence/fm/model.json or an existing bundle file and names the path the user should open instead, rather than overwriting a model.

The project store's fingerprint is a sha1 over either the bundle's bytes or every source file's path and content joined with NUL separators in path order, and returns null for a missing or empty source; the shell exposes no fingerprint IPC channel, so the renderer learns about external writes from the watcher event while the fingerprint is exercised by the store's own tests.

All shell consumers resolve paths through three helpers in modelSource.ts: isBundleProject tests for a *.evidence.json path, projectDirectoryOf returns the project root for a tree and the bundle's parent directory for a bundle, and modelSourceOf returns <root>/.evidence/fm for a tree and the bundle file itself; there is no trace-path helper, so traces are no longer placed at a fixed path beside the project directory.

Opening or creating a project starts a watcher keyed by WebContents id: a tree watches its root plus entities, relationships and rules non-recursively, a bundle watches its parent directory so a rename-save does not detach it, and both debounce events before emitting evidence:project:changed.

Review export runs in the main process from on-disk sources: a diff review first asks for a portable *.evidence.json baseline snapshot and reads it as a file rather than executing Git, then a save path is chosen, scope refs are derived from the model's non-child entry Contexts when .evidence/api/api.json exists, page assets resolve from the packaged resources directory or the workspace package, and the call returns saved, cancelled or failed instead of throwing across IPC.

The renderer selects its screen from the window hash: parseRoute returns the editor route with the decoded rootPath for /editor?rootPath=..., keeps a missing root path empty so the editor can explain it, and defaults every other hash to the dashboard, so an unknown hash never yields a blank window.

The dashboard loads recent projects and starter templates in parallel on mount, opens a project by calling projects.open and then projects.openEditorWindow, and creating a project uses showCreateDialog to pick a tree directory or a bundle file path, writes the starter document, starts the watcher for the requesting window and is echoed back through openEditorWindow; listProjectTemplates builds each template to report its real entity, relationship and rule counts, and the blank template is hidden from the starter cards.

Recent projects live in userData/recent-projects.json, are capped at 20 entries and deduplicated by rootPath, are rewritten through a temporary file plus atomic rename, and an unreadable or missing file degrades to an empty list instead of a startup failure.

The editor window subscribes to projects.onChanged and records only the change timestamp, so an external write produces a reload prompt and reloadFromDisk re-opens the project through projects.open rather than the canvas being replaced silently.

previewReview renders review HTML for the live unsaved document in the main process from the installed page assets, compares a fingerprint of the disk inputs before and after, and refuses with a changed-disk error instead of returning a page assembled from mixed revisions.

Delivery exposes two sources over IPC: the live pair projects an explicit document revision and freezes it with structuredClone before the directory picker, refusing export when the preview reports blocking issues or a stale modelDigest and writing draft-status.json with releaseAuthorized false, while the disk pair reads the saved model source and writes the contract, topology, routes and deployment sketch into the chosen directory.

Simulation IPC exposes replay, drift and a trace picker that all answer from the saved model in the main process, reading and parsing the OTLP/JSON trace there, lazily importing the service unless a test injects one, and returning a dispose that removes all three handlers.

Ingestion runs entirely in the main process: draft reads a contract by clauses, a blueprint table or business text, preferring a configured model and falling back to the built-in vocabulary while reporting why, and compile refuses a draft that yields no entity, writes it through createFromDocument and opens the new project's editor window.

registerAgentIpc keeps one runtime per project root, creates it lazily on the first call from a window, tracks which windows own which root, and disposes the runtime when that window is destroyed or the app quits.

An agent patch is applied by the renderer: the main process sends evidence:agent:apply-patch with a fresh request id and resolves with the renderer's verdict on evidence:agent:apply-patch-result, refusing immediately with '编辑器窗口已关闭。' when the window is destroyed and with a retry message after the 15 second timeout.

The MCP bridge resolves its renderer through getActiveContents, which is the first window from listEditorWindows, pushes evidence:mcp:status to every live window so a late window is not stuck on a dead bridge, and requires the same window to answer both get_capture_rect and model calls so a screenshot cannot come from a different window than the model the agent read.
